topic: Multiple Placement UX From Playtester Feedback
userLatestRead: Discord playtester TuloWodash reported that placing items feels janky and gets annoying when you own multiples. User asked to fix it and add him to playtester credits.
currentGoal: Make world-object placement less janky when the player owns multiple copies, while preserving existing saves and confirming TuloWodash is credited as a playtester.

sessionOutcome.credits: TuloWodash was already present in the TitleScene Playtesters list, so no duplicate credit entry was added.

changesMade.summary: PlacementSystem now supports slot-based placement keys. The first owned copy keeps the legacy key like field_mouse; extra copies use keys like field_mouse#2 and field_mouse#3.

GameScene tracks the selected placement slot, shows dock progress such as 1/3, keeps placement mode active while unplaced copies remain, and lets a player click a placed helper to move that exact slot.
Placed-object sync removes stale placements whose object is unowned, whose tile is gone, or whose slot is above the currently owned quantity.
Animal companion local targeting now considers every valid placed copy instead of only the first legacy placement key.
Confirmed TuloWodash is already listed under Playtesters in src/game/scenes/TitleScene.ts.

verificationRun.command: rg checks for stale placement helper imports/references
verificationRun.result: passed; old getPlacedObjectAt/getNearbyPlacedObjectIds usage removed from GameScene.

currentGitStatus: Gameplay changes are local and uncommitted.
Pre-existing unrelated tracked edits remain in AGENTS.md and docs/DESKTOP_MAC_SYNC_WORKFLOW.md.
Pre-existing unrelated untracked docs/media/test handoff files remain untouched.
This handoff and LATEST.json are expected to be dirty after this session.
knownIssuesAndRisks: No browser placement choreography smoke test was run; build and code-path review passed.
Sprinkler remains intentionally single-placement even if future systems ever report multiple owned sprinkler units.
Slot-key saves are backward-compatible for existing first placements, but future migration/docs should treat object#N keys as intentional.
nextRecommendedSteps: Playtest buying multiple companions and placing them from the dock: the label should advance 0/N, 1/N, 2/N and stay in placement mode until all owned copies are placed.
Playtest clicking an already placed companion: it should select that exact helper for moving and should not consume the next unplaced slot.
If the user asks to ship this, stage only the intended gameplay/handoff files and leave unrelated dirty docs/media alone.
doNotRevert: Do not collapse placedWorldObjects back to one placement per object id; object#2/object#3 slot keys are deliberate.
Do not duplicate TuloWodash in credits; he is already in the Playtesters list.
